purpose: Teach: フレッツ/エンタテイメント/ラストシーン/ポッドキャスティング/ヤンキース/ソフトボール/ホステス/タッグ
target_vocab: ポッドキャスティング

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが我が家のフレッツ光をアップグレードして下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father's upgrading our Flets connection for us.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. Slight lift on 'father'—pride in him without making it theatrical. Even tempo. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとエンタテイメント番組を観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched an entertainment program with Dad today.
lines.style: Bright and direct, eager to report. Quick pace. Natural child's excitement without being performed—he's genuinely pleased. Open vowels.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアニメ映画のラストシーンに感激されてたわ
lines.en: Sho — your father was really moved by the last scene of that anime film.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost to herself. Warm recognition of his feeling. Slight pause before 'really moved'—noticing something tender in him. Gentle trailing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとポッドキャスティング配信を一緒に聴いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I listened to a podcast together today.
lines.style: Same bright directness as before. Quick rhythm, genuine pride in the shared moment. No irony—just reporting what happened. Clear and present.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが昔のヤンキースの試合動画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father's been watching old Yankees game footage.
lines.style: Light observation tinged with quiet affection. Soft, almost amused at the specificity of his interests. Unhurried. The tone of someone noticing a detail and finding it endearing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと公園でソフトボールやったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I played softball in the park today.
lines.style: Proud and warm. Emphasis on 'played'—the doing together matters. Steady, grounded tone. Not rushing through it. He's savoring the memory as he tells it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ホステス文学にも価値がある」って語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your father said something really thoughtful about hostess literature having real value.
lines.style: Genuine respect in her voice. Slow, deliberate delivery—she's repeating something worth remembering. Tender admiration for his kindness and depth. No irony, no distance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと家族でタッグ組む大切さを学んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I learned something important from Dad today—how much it means when families work together as a team.
lines.style: Quiet but solid. The tone of a child who's understood something bigger than usual. No rush. Thoughtful pauses. The voice of someone who's genuinely touched and holding onto the moment.
